status_semantics.completed: Parent explicitly attests completion through the supplied prefix; agents 7+ also have retained reports.
status_semantics.in_progress: Actually assigned, but completion is not attested by this generation's prefix; a retained report alone is insufficient.
status_semantics.pending_not_spawned: Target slot only; absent from actual session-state assignments.

completion_attestation.source: Explicit parent --completed-through argument; session-state completion fields are not used.

scheduling.description: Ten logical waves group six target slots each. Capacity is three concurrent subagents beside root. The two logical batches per wave group slots, not a timestamped execution trace. Review and handoff work can overlap across waves; there are no strict wave barriers or six-way concurrency claims.

evidence_policy: Completed means an assignment finished, not that every reviewed experiment passed or that a project gate closed.
Agents 1–6 retain explicit parent summaries; no original self-authored reports are claimed.
Agents 1–36 retain the earlier scoped role/result wording. Their raw report hashes are refreshed from current retained bytes.
Agents 37+ use actual canonical task roles and attributed report excerpts or explicit parent summaries. Consult each full report for scope and qualifications.
Host, extracted-parser, stub, preliminary-native and frozen-matrix evidence remain distinct; historical failed packets remain failed.
Only actual dispatches appear as assignments. Target slots and report existence cannot manufacture completion.
This ledger does not establish hosted CI, vendor hw_emu, FPGA, silicon, P01 completion or P02 start.
Raw SHA-256 values identify retained inputs. The packet index separately binds raw bytes to path-substituted archive members.

source_snapshot.note: Current session-state bytes and file modification time were read for this generation. Recorded revision labels are attributed to session state; no Git identity or test was rerun.

parent_update_instructions: Update session-state waves only with actual canonical assignments, and retain each completed report before advancing --completed-through.

After agent 60 returns its final report, let the parent run --completed-through 60 and then build the packet. Do not fabricate a self-completion or embed the final ledger's own hash in agent 60's report.
If any report or session-state input changes, rerun the finalizer before rebuilding the packet; the packet builder performs publication path substitution and records both raw and published hashes.
